notes: CYBER-FROST-3.8 (Blackfrost-AI fine-tune of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next), peasantsmith PS-GUFF Q5_K_M requant (Q5_K/IQ4_NL experts, imatrix). Sampling is the model card's (temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20). Speculation tuned on this machine (5 prompts x 2 runs x 2 sweeps, temperature 1.0): draft 5 / cutoff 0.8 decodes ~47.5 tok/s vs ~45.7 at 4 / 0.8, ~44 at 4 / 0.7 and ~41 with the engine defaults (3 / 0.5). Its MTP head is byte-identical to the official one, so the stock draft layer is the model's own. bnk-bench (2026-10-05) scored it higher at temperature 0.6 than 1.0 (0.82 vs 0.74, mainly fewer runaway-thinking cap-outs); kept at the card's 1.0 for persona, but 0.6 is the accuracy-first choice.
